Organizations should address risks both before and after deploying advanced AI systems by taking appropriate measures throughout the development lifecycle to identify, evaluate, and mitigate risks. This includes employing diverse internal and independent external testing measures, such as red-teaming, to ensure the trustworthiness, safety, and security of systems. Testing should occur at several checkpoints, particularly before deployment, to identify risks and vulnerabilities.

After deployment, organizations should monitor for vulnerabilities, incidents, and emerging risks, and take appropriate action to address these. They are encouraged to facilitate third-party and user discovery and reporting of issues, maintain documentation of reported incidents, and collaborate with stakeholders to mitigate identified risks. Additionally, organizations should publicly report on the capabilities, limitations, and appropriate use of their advanced AI systems to enhance transparency and accountability.
